newsitem.title: USA: Florida okays regents issue, four housing bonds.
newsitem.headline: Florida okays regents issue, four housing bonds.

text.p: Florida executive officials gave final approval Tuesday to four Florida Housing Finance Agency bond issues and a Board of Regents issue totalling $107.285 million, the state Division of Bond Finance said Tuesday.
The largest of those, a $61.575 million single-family housing issue, will be sold by competitive bid on Wednesday. It will be the housing agency's first competitive deal in 16 years.
Also approved at the state Cabinet meeting Tuesday were
--a $22.85 million housing revenue bond issue for the Mariner Club Apartments Project
--an $8.92 million housing revenue bond issue for the Woodbridge Apartments Project
--a $7.75 million housing revenue bond issue for Tiffany Club Apartments Project, and
--a $6.185 million State Board of Regents issue, designated, University of Central Florida Bookstore Revenue Bonds 1996, for bookstore renovation and expansion.
